lessons.title: How lessons work
lessons.summary: Reading, saving your place, and the different boxes you'll see.

blocks.text: Each lesson is split into **parts**. Scroll through at your own pace — a part counts as *read* once you reach its end, and a small dot appears beside its title.

items: Tap the **list icon** (top right) to jump to any part.
Tap **Aa** to make the text bigger or smaller.
Tap the **bookmark** beside a part's title to keep it in the Saved tab.

blocks.text: BitSync remembers where you stopped. The **Continue reading** card on the home screen brings you right back.

lessons.title: Math and worked examples
lessons.summary: Formulas, and examples you reveal one step at a time.

blocks.text: Math appears inline, like $y' + P(x)y = Q(x)$, or on its own line:
The integrating factor is a helper you multiply by so the left side becomes the derivative of one product, $\left(\mu y\right)'$.
Tap **Show step 1** to go one step at a time. Every step tells you *what* to do and *why*.

steps.why: The equation already matches the standard form $y' + P(x)y = Q(x)$.
We drop the constant of integration here — any one integrating factor works.
This makes the left side the derivative of a single product.

steps.do: Rewrite the left side as one derivative.
steps.why: By the product rule, $(e^{2x}y)' = e^{2x}y' + 2e^{2x}y$ — exactly our left side.

blocks.text: When $P$ and $Q$ are both constants, the equation is also **separable**: $\dfrac{dy}{4-2y} = dx$. Use whichever method you find faster.
